unknownBarcodeDialog.descriptionCashier: This barcode was read successfully, but no product uses it yet. Ask an admin to add it to the system.

camera.title: Scan with camera
camera.hint: Hold the barcode steady in view, then tap Scan.

camera.cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Check permissions and try again.

voidCart.title: Clear the cart?
voidCart.description: Clearing a cart with items is recorded in the audit log. If you are not authorized to void, enter a manager PIN.

checkoutDialog.title: Checkout
checkoutDialog.cardHint: The payment is recorded as a card transaction. Use the bank terminal as usual.
checkoutDialog.managerPinOptional: Manager PIN, if a large discount needs approval
checkoutDialog.offlineNotice: No connection. Cash sales are saved on this device and sent automatically when you reconnect. Card is unavailable.
checkoutDialog.offlineDiscountBlocked: This discount needs a manager approval, which requires a connection. Reduce the discount or reconnect.
checkoutDialog.queuedDone: Saved offline as P-{number}. It will sync automatically.
checkoutDialog.cardReferenceHint: Charge the card on the bank terminal first, then type the approval code (RRN) it prints. Never type a card number here.
checkoutDialog.tenderedTooLarge: That amount is too large. Scanned a barcode by mistake? Clear it and type the cash received.
checkoutDialog.offlineCatalogExpired: Offline prices are too old (over 3 days) or were never synced. Reconnect to refresh them before selling.

register.offlineCatalog: Offline: showing the last synced catalog. Stock figures are approximate.

customer.offlineNote: Customers and promotions need a connection and are skipped offline.

customer.description: Optional. Look the customer up by their exact phone number. Their details are not shown here.
customer.notFound: No customer with this number. Register them:
customer.name: Name
customer.consent: Customer agrees to receive marketing messages
customer.consentHint: Leave off unless the customer clearly says yes. It can be withdrawn at any time.

register.scanBlocked: The scan was ignored: finish or close the open window first.
register.unknownPlu: This scale label is for PLU {plu}, but no product has that PLU. Add the PLU code to the product first.
register.notByWeight: PLU {plu} is on a weight label, but that product is not sold by the kilo.
register.multiplierWholeOnly: This item is sold per piece: use a whole number.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.gateDescription: Enter your opening cash float to start selling.
shifts.managerPinOptional: Manager PIN, if approval is required
shifts.safe_dropHint: Cash transferred from the drawer to the safe.
shifts.shiftStillOpen: This shift is still open — the Z-report is available after closing.

capabilities.title: Permissions for {name}
capabilities.description: Extra authority for this staff member. Admins already have everything. Changes are audited.

hints.cart_void: Clearing a cart needs no manager PIN.
hints.discount_override: Discounts above the limit need no approval.

hints.cash_drawer_adjust: Records cash movements without a manager PIN.
hints.shift_close_override: Closes a shift even with a large cash variance.

reports.subtitle: Sales performance for the selected period.
reports.profitNote: Net of VAT. Cost uses each product's current cost, so editing a cost shifts past profit.
reports.rangeInvalid: The start date must be on or before the end date.

receipt.thankYou: Thank you for shopping with us!
receipt.reprintDescription: Reprints are logged with who printed them and why. The copy is marked COPY.
receipt.reprintReason: Reason (for example: customer lost the receipt)

receipt.usingBrowser: No receipt printer paired on this browser: using the browser print dialog.
receipt.printedAlready: Already printed once; further prints are reprints.
receipt.drawerFailed: The cash drawer did not open: {error}

returns.title: Return items
returns.description: Returns are recorded as a separate audited document; the original receipt is unchanged.
returns.noRestockWarning: Inventory will not be restored for this return.
returns.managerPinOptional: Manager PIN, if approval is required
returns.cardRefundPending: Card refund recorded. Do the refund on the bank terminal, then confirm it under Payments.

offline.title: Pending sales
offline.description: Cash sales made while offline are saved on this device and sent to the server in order. The server decides the final receipt number, stock and totals.
offline.syncFailed: Could not reach the server. Sales stay queued.
offline.offlineWaiting: You are offline. Queued sales will sync when the connection returns.
offline.attention: {count} sale(s) were rejected by the server and need a decision: retry or resolve them.
offline.otherCashier: Waiting for that cashier to sign in
offline.resolveDescription: Record how this sale was settled (for example refunded in cash and re-rung). The sale stays on record and is never deleted.
offline.resolveNeedsNote: A note is required to resolve a sale.
offline.empty: No offline sales on this device.
offline.rejectedToast: {count} offline sale(s) were rejected. Open Pending sales.

provisionalHint.queued: Saved on this device. The final receipt number is assigned when it syncs.
provisionalHint.synced: Synced. Use the final receipt for returns and records.
provisionalHint.rejected: The server rejected this sale. Open Pending sales to resolve it.
provisionalHint.resolved: This rejected sale was resolved by staff.

offline.notFound: This offline sale is not on this device.
offline.needsSignIn: Your session expired. Sign in again to send {count} queued sale(s).

stocktakes.title: Stocktakes
stocktakes.description: Count stock in full or by category. Entering counts never changes stock; only an admin's approval does, and every adjustment is recorded as a stock movement.
stocktakes.newDescription: Expected quantities are frozen when the count starts, so sales during the count are surfaced for review instead of silently skewing it.
stocktakes.scanHint: Scan a barcode to add one unit to that line (kg items: type the weight). Entries save automatically; you can pause and resume at any time.
stocktakes.notInCount: Barcode {barcode} is not part of this count.
stocktakes.awaitingApproval: This count is waiting for an admin to review and approve it.
stocktakes.cancelledNotice: This count was cancelled. No stock was changed.
stocktakes.conflictsNotice: {count} line(s) had stock movements after the count started. Choose how to settle each one.
stocktakes.resolveFirst: Resolve {count} flagged line(s) to enable approval.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.newDescription: Costs are per unit, excluding VAT, in EGP. The order is saved as a draft; place it when it is sent to the supplier.
purchaseOrders.closedDone: Order closed. The remainder will not be received.
purchaseOrders.receiveDescription: Receive part or all of the order. Over-receipt is allowed only up to {pct}% above the ordered quantity. Stock and average cost update once per receipt.
purchaseOrders.receivedCostNote: Costs are the invoiced prices at receipt, excluding VAT; VAT uses each line's rate. Sales profit uses the cost snapshot taken at sale time.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Customer profiles are optional and consent-based. Only staff with customer access can see this list; cashiers can look a customer up by exact phone number at the register.
customers.name: Name
customers.anonymizeDescription: Name, phone and email are permanently removed and consent is withdrawn. Past sales keep an anonymous link so accounting stays correct. This cannot be undone.
customers.anonymizedNotice: This customer has been anonymized. Their personal data was removed.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Rule-based discounts evaluated by the server at checkout. A promotion's terms cannot be edited after creation (create a new one); you can switch it off at any time, and past sales keep what they were charged.
promotions.newDescription: Promotions run in priority order. Manual discounts apply first; promotions act on what is left.
promotions.codeHint: Optional. Without a code it applies automatically.
promotions.eligibilityHint: Leave category and products empty to include every product.
promotions.customerRequired: Requires a customer on the sale
promotions.stackableHint: Off: it skips lines that already have a promotion and blocks later ones on the lines it touches.
promotions.name: Name

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every card and cash movement is a payment record. Pending, failed and unmatched payments appear here until someone confirms or resolves them, so nothing is silently lost.
payments.attentionEmpty: Nothing needs attention. All payments are settled.

reasonHint.pending: Check the terminal. If it approved, enter the approval code and confirm. If not, mark it failed.
reasonHint.orphan: The card was charged but no sale was recorded. Re-ring the sale or refund the customer, then resolve this with a note.
reasonHint.refundPending: Do the refund on the terminal, then enter its reference and confirm.
reasonHint.refundFailed: The refund did not go through. Settle it with the customer, then resolve this with a note.

payments.failTitle: Mark this payment as not completed
payments.failDescription: Record what happened. The payment stays on record with this reason.
payments.resolveDescription: Say how it was settled (for example refunded on the terminal and the sale re-rung). The record is kept.
payments.summaryEmpty: No captured payments in this period.
payments.reconciliationNote: Checks that every sale is paid exactly by its captured payments and flags payments without a sale or stuck in pending.
payments.reconciliationClean: Everything reconciles: no mismatches or open exceptions in this period.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Declare the hardware at each till. Printing and drawer actions are logged with the staff member and till. Browser printing always works as a fallback.
devices.noWebUsb: This browser does not support WebUSB, so a thermal printer cannot be driven. Use Chrome or Edge over HTTPS; the browser print dialog still works.
devices.failedJobs: {count} recent print job(s) failed. They can be retried from the receipt.
devices.addDescription: Only profiles marked as supported can be added.
devices.notPaired: No paired USB printer found in this browser.
devices.empty: No devices declared for this till yet.
devices.openDrawerDescription: A manual opening is audited. Give a reason; without the cash-drawer permission a manager PIN is needed.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.description: Reports use the store timezone to decide which business day a sale belongs to. Egypt changes its clocks, so day lengths of 23 and 25 hours are handled automatically.
settings.identityHint: Printed on every receipt, return receipt and Z-report. Leave a field empty to leave it off the receipt.
settings.weighedHint: For deli/produce scales that print a barcode holding the item code and the weight or price. Give each such product its scale code (PLU) in the product form. Print one test label to confirm the layout before enabling.
settings.weighedEnabled: Read scale labels at the register

daily.title: Daily close
daily.description: Totals per business day in {tz}. Gross is what customers paid (VAT included); net excludes VAT. Refunds, discounts and voids are reported separately.
daily.grossNote: Cash and card are net of refunds paid out in that tender. A closed day is an immutable snapshot of these totals.
daily.noVoids: No cart voids in this period.

vat.title: VAT summary
vat.description: Output VAT on sales by rate, reduced by VAT refunded on returns, next to the input VAT paid on goods received. Gross includes VAT; net does not.
vat.note: This is an operational summary to prepare your VAT return; confirm the figures and format with your accountant before filing.

stock.title: Stock reports
stock.description: Movements, valuation at cost and retail, and how long stock has gone unsold.
stock.noMovements: No stock movements in this period.
stock.valuationNote: Cost is the moving average of invoiced unit costs (ex VAT). Retail gross includes VAT; retail net removes it.
stock.agingNote: Measured as days since the product last sold. The system keeps an average cost rather than cost layers, so the age of individual batches is not known.

reorder.title: Reorder suggestions
reorder.description: Based on net sales over the last {lookback} days and a target cover of {cover} days, plus the supplier's lead time. Open the explanation to see every input.
reorder.whyDescription: How this quantity was worked out.

alerts.title: Low-stock alerts
alerts.description: A product appears here when its stock falls to its low-stock threshold, and leaves when stock recovers.
alerts.dismissDescription: It stays quiet until the product's stock recovers. A note is required.
alerts.orderedDescription: Choose the order that covers this product.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.advisory: Advisory only. It can read stock, prices and sales; it cannot change anything. Check important answers in the POS.
assistant.hint: Ask about stock, prices, or today's sales.

errors.signedOut: Please sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot use the assistant.
errors.tooLong: That message is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: You are asking too fast. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.quota: The AI service has reached its usage limit. Try again later. The register and everything else keep working normally.
errors.misconfigured: The assistant is not configured. Ask an admin to check the AI keys. The register keeps working normally.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. The register and everything else keep working normally.
errors.network: Could not reach the assistant. Check the connection. The register is not affected.

deviceErrors.noPrinter: No receipt printer is connected. Use the browser print instead.
deviceErrors.noInterface: The printer did not offer a usable USB connection.
deviceErrors.noEndpoint: The printer has no data channel the browser can write to.
deviceErrors.usbTransfer: The printer stopped answering. Check the cable, paper and power, then try again.
deviceErrors.webUsbUnavailable: This browser cannot talk to the printer. Use Chrome or Edge over HTTPS, or the desktop app.
deviceErrors.disconnected: The device was disconnected. Plug it back in and try again.
deviceErrors.accessDenied: The browser was not allowed to use the device. Allow access when asked.
deviceErrors.printFailed: The receipt could not be printed.
deviceErrors.drawerNotOpened: The cash drawer did not open.
